features.title: A backrest that supports where it matters
features.text: The thoughtfully designed mid-backrest provides gentle support to your shoulders and spine, so you can sit comfortably without strain, whether for work or relaxation.

features.title: Spacious armrests, effortless comfort
features.text: Designed with broad, supportive armrests that let you sit, lean, or lounge with ease—offering the perfect balance of comfort and ergonomic support, no matter how you choose to relax.

features.title: Soft foam for plush comfort
features.text: Equipped with soft foam cushioning, this sofa provides excellent support for long hours of lounging, reading, or simply relaxing.

features.title: Built to last for years
features.text: Made with a solid wood frame, this sofa is durable enough to handle daily use and still look great—perfect for active households or anyone who loves lasting quality.

features.title: Timeless design that suits any space
features.text: With its symmetrical and clean stitching lines, this sofa blends contemporary style with timeless appeal, fitting beautifully into any décor.
